# tep-rust TESUB7 vectors, format 1
#
# Recorded from the ORIGINAL Fortran. The Rust TepRng is checked against
# these, so they must never be regenerated from the Rust implementation:
# that would make the test compare the port with itself.
#
# Regenerate with:
#   cargo run -p tepsim-oracle --features oracle --bin gen-rng-vectors
#
# gfortran: 15.2.0
# fflags: -c -O0 -fno-fast-math -fno-unsafe-math-optimizations -fPIC -std=legacy
# fold is the XOR of the bit patterns of every state in the run.
# All values are hexadecimal IEEE-754 f64 bit patterns.
